_comment: Reviewed list of Mac-only menu/control labels that are never a Lulo gap: OS chrome, iCloud-only features, and services Lulo has deliberately not promised. `app` is "*" for every app or a Lulo app display name. `match` is "exact" (default) or "prefix". Add rows here only after a human confirms the item is genuinely out of scope, with a reason a reviewer can check.

entries.label: Apple
entries.reason: The system Apple menu is OS chrome (About This Mac, System Settings…, Sleep/Restart/Shut Down, Recent Items, App Store updates), not part of any app's own menu bar. Lulo's shell has no per-app equivalent slot for it.

entries.label: SF Mono Regular 11
entries.reason: SF Mono is an Apple font; Lulo uses its bundled monospace font and exposes the font size separately.

entries.label: Services
entries.reason: Services is populated system-wide from every installed app's Info.plist; Lulo has no Services architecture and nothing to port.

entries.label: AutoFill
entries.reason: AppKit's AutoFill submenu belongs to macOS's system Contacts and Passwords services, which System Monitor cannot access on Linux.

entries.label: Contact…
entries.reason: Opens a macOS Contacts AutoFill picker tied to the user's Apple Contacts data.

entries.label: Passwords…
entries.reason: Opens the macOS Passwords AutoFill picker backed by Apple Passwords and iCloud Keychain.

entries.label: Credit Card…
entries.reason: Opens macOS's protected payment-card AutoFill picker backed by Apple Wallet or Safari data.

entries.label: Run Spindump
entries.reason: Runs Apple's macOS spindump utility and produces a .spin report, neither of which exists on Linux.

entries.label: Run System Diagnostics…
entries.reason: Invokes Apple's macOS sysdiagnose collection and its proprietary report format.

entries.label: Recent Items
entries.reason: AppKit's own Recent Items submenu under the Apple menu (the app's own File > Open Recent is tracked separately and is NOT allowlisted).

entries.label: Start Dictation…
entries.reason: Apple dictation (on-device/cloud speech-to-text) is an Apple Intelligence/Siri feature with no Linux equivalent shipped yet.

entries.label: Emoji & Symbols
entries.reason: The macOS character viewer is a system input-method feature, not an app menu command; Lulo has its own emoji picker reachable another way (tracked separately in docs/parity.md, not here).

entries.label: Share…
entries.reason: macOS Share sheets hand off to iCloud/AirDrop/Mail/Messages/social extensions. Lulo has no share-sheet architecture; this is a standing, intentionally-deferred gap tracked as a whole in docs/parity.md rather than per occurrence here.

entries.label: Add to Dock
entries.reason: macOS-specific Dock integration for files, distinct from Lulo's own Dock (which already pins apps); porting "add a file alias to the Dock" is not planned.

entries.label: Make Alias
entries.reason: Classic Mac OS aliases (resolved by Finder/the OS at open time) have no Linux filesystem equivalent; Lulo would need symlinks instead, tracked as a design question in docs/parity.md, not a straight menu-item port.

entries.label: Compress using Keka
entries.reason: Injected by the Keka Finder Sync extension installed on the reference Mac, not by stock Finder. Any third-party Finder extension's rows are machine-specific and never a Lulo gap; re-check this list if the reference Mac's installed extensions change.

entries.label: Extract using Keka
entries.reason: See "Compress using Keka": the Keka Finder Sync extension, not stock Finder.

entries.label: Send to Keka
entries.reason: See "Compress using Keka": the Keka Finder Sync extension, not stock Finder.

entries.label: MSI G241
entries.reason: This soft-proof ICC profile belongs to the reference Mac's attached MSI monitor; it is machine-specific, not a Preview feature.

entries.label: Colour LCD
entries.reason: This soft-proof ICC profile belongs to Apple's built-in laptop display and does not exist on Lulo hardware.

entries.label: Share
entries.reason: This is macOS's system Share sheet for AirDrop, Mail, Messages, and share extensions; Lulo has no Apple Share service.

entries.label: No Document
entries.reason: AppKit inserts this disabled placeholder in empty Revert To and Share submenus; it is not a command.

entries.label: <<Import From Device - unlocalized>>
entries.reason: This unlocalized Image Capture framework placeholder belongs to macOS's device-import service, not a Preview command.

entries.label: AutoFill
entries.reason: This submenu is provided by Apple's system Contacts and Passwords AutoFill services, which Lulo does not have.

entries.label: Contact…
entries.reason: This inserts a macOS Contacts card through Apple's system AutoFill service.

entries.label: Passwords…
entries.reason: This opens Apple's Passwords/Keychain AutoFill service, unavailable on Linux.

entries.label: Credit Card…
entries.reason: This uses Apple's saved payment-card AutoFill service, unavailable on Linux.

entries.label: Accounts…
entries.reason: Opens macOS Internet Accounts for Apple Account and iCloud Notes; Lulo stores notes locally.

entries.label: <<Import From Device - unlocalized>>
entries.reason: Continuity import from a nearby iPhone or iPad requires Apple's device services.

entries.label: Open in Pages
entries.reason: Hands the note to Apple's Pages app, which is unavailable on Linux.

entries.label: Share
entries.reason: Opens the macOS share sheet for AirDrop, iCloud collaboration and Apple apps.

entries.label: Note “
entries.reason: Share submenu targets are private notes in the reference Mac's iCloud library, not stock app commands.

entries.label: AutoFill
entries.reason: macOS contact and credential AutoFill uses Apple system data providers.

entries.label: Contact…
entries.reason: The macOS AutoFill contact card is provided by Apple Contacts.

entries.label: Passwords…
entries.reason: The macOS AutoFill password picker uses Apple Passwords and Keychain.

entries.label: Credit Card…
entries.reason: The macOS AutoFill card picker uses Apple Wallet and Keychain.

entries.label: Show Note Activity
entries.reason: Shows iCloud collaboration events for a shared note.

entries.label: Show Folder Activity
entries.reason: Shows iCloud collaboration events for a shared folder.

entries.label: Photo Browser
entries.reason: Opens the Apple Photos library browser, which is unavailable on Linux.
